cohort: 42 neonates admitted to Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital between January 2017 and May 2018 with positive blood and cerebrospinal fluid culture with Listeria monocytogenes.
finding: The majority of neonates infected with Listeria monocytogenes were born preterm and presented with respiratory distress or depression within the first 6 days of life, with a high proportion having meningitis and a high mortality rate.
mod_finding: 78.6% of the neonates with Listeria monocytogenes infection were born via vaginal delivery.
